name: Stagehand Browser
description: AI-native browser automation via Browserbase Stagehand — hosted and self-hosted MCP presets plus a /stagehand setup guide.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Opens the /stagehand setup guide modal that compares the hosted and self-hosted presets and links into MCP settings.
permissionJustifications.shell:execute: Runs `node --version` and `npx --version` when you press 'Check environment' in the /stagehand guide — the only two commands, both covered by shellCommands.

browser.reason: The self-hosted preset spawns @browserbasehq/mcp via npx, and the setup guide's environment check needs the desktop shell.

mobile.reason: The self-hosted preset spawns @browserbasehq/mcp via npx — unavailable on mobile.

mcpServerPresets.name: Stagehand — Hosted
mcpServerPresets.description: Browserbase's hosted Streamable-HTTP endpoint — no local Node.js, and the default Gemini model cost is covered. The API key goes in a request header so it is stored in the credential vault.

fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: Leave as-is for the default Gemini model. Optional query params: ?modelName=…&modelApiKey=…&keepAlive=true&proxies=true.

mcpServerPresets.name: Stagehand — Self-hosted
mcpServerPresets.description: AI-native browser automation (act / extract / observe / agent). Spawns @browserbasehq/mcp over stdio; sessions run on Browserbase cloud Chromium.

fields.label: Gemini API key (Stagehand model)
fields.description: Stagehand defaults to google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Pass --modelName plus --modelApiKey in the server args to use a different provider.

commands.name: /stagehand
commands.description: Open the Stagehand browser setup guide — compare hosted vs self-hosted presets and jump to the right gallery card.
